channel.title: Baldar: honey from the Kara-Buura hills
channel.description: sixty hives, one old man, and a daughter who types

item.title: Winter house
item.description: Hives into the winter house today. Fifty. We closed the door at dusk. Tilek says that it is the first time he heard the hum with his own ears: he put his ear to the box and went quiet and said, "Ata, it sounds like a road." I said: yes. That is the road. @end

item.title: The last harvest, maybe
item.description: Tilek and I. 50 hives. 23 kg a hive. Mountain flowers 38 som a kilo, sainfoin 30. This summer the buyers in Talas who always paid in dollars said they cannot get the dollars. So they pay in som, and the som is enough for a man who lives in the mountains. Gulmira apa, if you read this: I kept your…

item.title: The grandson works
item.description: This year Tilek ran the extractor, I watched. 24 kg a hive. I did not touch a frame. It was strange, but he does it better than me. My hands tremble. He wants to build a second shed with a proper floor. I said, build it.

item.title: Fifty hives
item.description: The apiary in the spring meadow. Fifty boxes. After the winter: 50 hives. I lost nine. Age. My back. I decided to keep fifty and not buy new. Tilek is 21 and studies in Talas but comes on weekends. He says he will take the apiary when I cannot. I told him to learn first.

item.title: Quiet
item.description: Everyone is careful this autumn. Nobody asks me about politics. They ask if there will be more honey next year.

item.title: Heat
item.description: Bees bearding on the hive fronts in the heat. Forty degrees. The bees are bearding on the front of the hives to cool them. A good sign, I think. 21 kg a hive. We sold out by the fifteenth of September. The price this year: 31 som for sainfoin and 35 for flowers. I did not raise it for the…

item.title: Forty-nine years
item.description: Forty-nine years yesterday. I went up as always. A young man was there with a camera from the university, to ask the old ones for their stories. I told him mine. It took an hour and he took notes and did not interrupt. That's all.

item.title: Dry year
item.description: A very dry year. The mountain flowers burned in July, there was little nectar. 9 kg a hive. We will sell less and keep the best for ourselves. The price will go up. I am sorry. The bees did not complain. They never do. They simply leave.

item.title: Quarantine honey
item.description: No bazaar, no bus, no one comes to the yard. I stand at the gate with my mask and the buyer stands two meters away and I put the jar on a stone. Tilek makes the deliveries by bicycle to the houses along the road and writes down the numbers. The old people say honey is a medicine. In this year…

item.title: Tulpar
item.description: Tilek put the Tulpar on my phone (I have a phone since last year). Now he has made me a channel called "Mamat's honey". It has 80 followers, mostly Gulmira's customers and Gulnaz's friends in the hospital. I do not understand how it works. People write "how much?" and I answer with a photograph of…
